EK_Lights@H1@V1-01.gdtf._notes: Philips 480W 6500K HID lamp. Lux 130000 @20 m at 2.1 deg beam mode (datasheet table; ~52 Mcd, page headline rounds to 20000 lux @50 m). 16300 lm from user manual (https://www.eklights.com/wp-content/uploads/product-downloads/H1/H1-user-manual.pdf). Zoom 2.1-29 beam mode, 2.2-42 spot mode. No IP rating stated for non-IP H1. Product page: https://www.eklights.com/products/h1/
